summary: GM Financial Automobile Leasing Trust 2026-2 filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a $1.193 billion asset-backed securitization of automobile lease assets. The offering includes six classes of notes with principal amounts ranging from $61.8 million to $441.25 million and interest rates of 3.831% to 4.60%, plus a floating-rate class. Joint bookrunners are Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Societe Generale, and TD Securities. The notes are backed by an exchange note secured by lease assets, with credit enhancement from excess cashflow, overcollateralization, subordination, and a reserve account. This is a routine structured finance transaction, not a special situation.
